## 6. Function

Implement exactly this behaviour (from the reference program's documentation):

```text
Scores a face run of detect_proto.py (--select 2 --out DIR) against the hand-labelled
  frames of skin_labels.json and street_scene's truth: per labelled frame, a labelled face is found
  when a face box measured on that frame (DIR/<name>_log.txt, grown by TOL pixels) holds its
  centre; a box that holds no labelled face's centre is counted false (an unlabelled face in the
  background counts false too, so the false count is an upper bound). Prints per clip and in all:
  faces found / labelled, false boxes.
```

Per function:

```text
frame_boxes: Face boxes (x0, y0, x1, y1) found on frame k (0-based) in a detect_proto log.
```
